definition: tests/test_navigator_coverage.py's module docstring. A baseline recorded under a different definition of a step is not comparable to this one.

previous.why_the_step_count_changed: Nine became eight because `codev slice begin` collapsed `begin_slice` and `start_round_state` into one transition. That is the lifecycle getting shorter, not the walk skipping a step -- creating a branch and opening round state are now one action, so they are one step. Every other step name is unchanged, which is what makes the two counts comparable at all.
